blocks.content: As you can see, we can replace the if...else statement with a ternary operator. This will make our code cleaner and shorter.
Here, both the programs check if the student has passed an exam or not. However, the use of the ternary operator has made our code cleaner and shorter.
In such cases, where we need to do a single task inside the if...else statement, we can replace it with a ternary operator.
But, if there are multiple lines of code inside the if...else statement, we should never replace the code with a ternary operator.
